operator_directive: The operator challenged the 2026-11-01 recert: the judge prompt grounded the model in the SUITES' own assertions only, never stated WHAT THE PRODUCT IS or what activation is supposed to look like, so MiniMax scored the D&D Beyond sheet itself (which fills the first frames) instead of the extension's work. Example miss: no suite asserts a basic activation loading overlay, so its absence was never priced. Re-run ALL 19 bundles with a goal-grounded prompt that (a) states the product brief, (b) explicitly excludes the base D&D sheet from being the extension's work, (c) judges in two layers: LAYER 1 = the suite's asserted behavior as before, LAYER 2 = product-aim conformance incl. basic affordances visible on camera even when no suite asserts them. Deliberation: adopted in-session with the operator (2026-11-01): scope = full re-run; rubric = both layers; single-answer decisions recorded as inadmissible candidates, not padded.
